_source: Portfolio/src/index.css :root motion block + Claude/consumer-motion-framework.md section 4. Values here are copied verbatim from index.css; the CSS stays the source of truth, this file is the Figma-facing mirror.

groups.name: ease
groups.note: Figma has no bezier value type; the curve is stored as its CSS string so it can be read into code verbatim. Spatial curves overshoot (y > 1), effects and cinematic curves do not.

tokens.name: ease/m3/spatial-expressive-fast
tokens.role: Bold movement, fast. Overshoots.

tokens.name: ease/m3/spatial-expressive-default
tokens.role: Bold movement, default. Entrance of a figure element (slight overshoot).

tokens.name: ease/m3/spatial-expressive-slow
tokens.role: Bold movement, slow. Overshoots.

tokens.name: ease/m3/spatial-standard-fast
tokens.role: Restrained movement, fast.

tokens.name: ease/m3/spatial-standard-default
tokens.role: Restrained movement, default. Position, size, transform.

tokens.name: ease/m3/spatial-standard-slow
tokens.role: Restrained movement, slow.

tokens.name: ease/m3/effects-fast
tokens.role: Opacity and color, fast. Flat, no overshoot.

tokens.name: ease/m3/effects-default
tokens.role: Opacity and color, default. Fades, crossfades, exits.

tokens.name: ease/m3/effects-slow
tokens.role: Opacity and color, slow.

tokens.name: ease/m3/emphasized-decelerate
tokens.role: Pure decelerate, no overshoot. Fade-up-from-black, per-word claim build. Promoted from ds/tokens.css.

tokens.name: ease/m3/standard-accelerate
tokens.role: Flat whip-through accelerate. The specular glint. Promoted from ds/tokens.css.

tokens.name: ease/ds/out
tokens.role: Enter, expand, settle. Alias of ease/m3/emphasized-decelerate.

tokens.name: ease/ds/exit
tokens.role: Exit, collapse. Equals M3 emphasized-accelerate.

tokens.name: ease/ds/pop
tokens.role: Press and pop, spring-ish. Equals M3 expressive.

tokens.name: ease/cine/glide
tokens.role: easeOutExpo. Signature long glide: from-the-void, soft entrance, timed parallax.

tokens.name: ease/cine/settle
tokens.role: easeOutQuint. Firmer no-overshoot landing: turntable, scale jump, mask wipe.

tokens.name: ease/cine/arrive
tokens.role: Asymmetric fly-in: fast out of the gate, very long park.

tokens.name: ease/cine/push
tokens.role: Long flat dolly glide, still creeping at the end.

tokens.name: duration/m3/effects-fast
tokens.role: Fast fade or color change; exits.

tokens.name: duration/m3/effects-default
tokens.role: Default fade or color change.

tokens.name: duration/m3/effects-slow
tokens.role: Slow fade; finish swatch crossfade.

tokens.name: duration/m3/spatial-fast
tokens.role: Fast movement; lower-third enter; specular sweep.

tokens.name: duration/m3/spatial-default
tokens.role: Default movement; figure entrance; pop-land number.

tokens.name: duration/m3/spatial-expressive-slow
tokens.role: Slow bold movement; fade up from black.

tokens.name: duration/m3/spatial-standard-slow
tokens.role: Slow restrained movement. The site ceiling for interaction-clock motion.

tokens.name: duration/cine/reveal
tokens.role: Hero reveal beat: from-the-void, turntable, mask wipe.

tokens.name: duration/cine/hero
tokens.role: Singular opener or climax only; also schedules the apex accent.

tokens.name: duration/cine/push
tokens.role: Slow push-in, pull-back, timed parallax.

tokens.name: duration/cine/effects-scene
tokens.role: Cross-dissolve, stage color shift, languid rack focus.

tokens.name: duration/cine/effects-cinematic
tokens.role: Slow hero light sweep on a flat curve.

tokens.name: duration/cine/atmosphere
tokens.role: Gradient-wash ambient drift loop.

tokens.name: duration/cine/word-build
tokens.role: Per-word duration in the claim build.

tokens.name: stagger/word
tokens.role: Inter-word delay in the claim build.

tokens.name: stagger/cine
tokens.role: Consumer group stagger default. Site B2B figures use about 60.

tokens.name: stagger/scroll
tokens.role: Enter-on-cross sibling stagger.

tokens.name: hold/cine
tokens.role: Hero arrived-state hold.

tokens.name: hold/still
tokens.role: The let-it-breathe pause.

tokens.name: hold/beat
tokens.role: Standard pause between serialized beats.

tokens.name: hold/crescendo-beat
tokens.role: The dramatic held pause in the single-word crescendo.

groups.name: scalar
groups.note: Unitless quantities, not curves or durations.

tokens.name: scalar/scrub-smoothing
tokens.role: Lerp per rAF tick for scroll-film catch-up.

tokens.name: scalar/parallax-back
tokens.role: Background plane rate.

tokens.name: scalar/parallax-mid
tokens.role: Midground (hero) plane rate.

tokens.name: scalar/parallax-fore
tokens.role: Foreground plane rate.

groups.name: spring
groups.note: Read via getComputedStyle for the motion library; a bezier cannot express a damping ratio.

tokens.name: spring/momentum/stiffness
tokens.role: Gesture or fling reward overshoot, damping ratio 0.8.

tokens.name: spring/momentum/damping
tokens.role: Gesture or fling reward overshoot, damping ratio 0.8.

tokens.name: spring/bloom/stiffness
tokens.role: Icon or glyph bloom from scale 0, small elastic settle.

tokens.name: spring/bloom/damping
tokens.role: Icon or glyph bloom from scale 0, small elastic settle.

tokens.name: spring/scrub/stiffness
tokens.role: Scroll-film catch-up spring (useSpring).

tokens.name: spring/scrub/damping
tokens.role: Scroll-film catch-up spring (useSpring).
